method: Lexical reconciliation of the main dispatcher, early command conditions and capability declarations. Identifier metadata only. Early conditions are candidates, not proof of public commands. Dynamic and delegated parser expansion lives in domain audits. Capability names are not authorization or execution proof. Feature flags and DEBUG alter availability. Counts are not implementation percentages.
